metadata.source: PSOC - Possible persistence via registry key detected.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC - Possible persistence via registry key detected
properties.query:
//this is to restrict the rule to servers only, endpoints often match this during updates
let RegistryKey = dynamic(["\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run","\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnceEx","\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunServices","\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunServicesOnce","\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\User Shell Folders","\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Explorer\\Shell Folders","\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce","\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run","\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon\\Shell","\\software\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Windows","\\Control\\Session Manager\\BootExecute","\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Event Viewer"]);
let process_Name  = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents 
| where FileName  has "reg.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("reg", "add")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (RegistryKey)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any (process_Name)
| extend
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessAccountName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessId", "")),
    CommandLineMapped = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessCommandLine", ""))
